notes: «أَبِی ره» : the compiler's father; «ره» is a blessing: left out
«عَنْ جَدِّهِ الْحُسَیْنِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ» : «جده» plus a name is one link, the name alone (owner rule 7)
«قَالَ حَدَّثَنِی أَبِی» : the Imam's own chain continues in his words; Ali after «عن» is a narrator link; the saying is Ali's
